text:
maria: Brain-dump: a 'shadow-mirror commit' rollout pattern. Run new variant as full mirror, start read-only, then enable write-capture (buffered) and finally commit. Goal: fast rollback + low side-effect risk.

needs: clear gating signals, cache warmup checks, side-effect handling, cost budget.

kevin: Sounds viable. How do we avoid stale KV cache hits on mirror?

maria: Warmup phase: mirror reads only, track KV hit-ratio slope. Only after hit-ratio stabilizes and similarity gates pass do we enable write-capture.

aj: Write-capture = per-tenant write-ahead buffer. Replay on commit with idempotency keys. If rollback, drop buffer. Avoid live duplicate side-effects.

lina: Gating signals suggestion: p95 latency <= 1.25x, error delta <= 0.2%, sample eval fail <= 1%, KV-hit slope ~0 for 10m, divergence embedding dist <= 0.18.

maria: Also add budget guardrails: soft alert at X USD/day, hard stop shadowing.

kevin: External webhooks and billing must be queued and deduped on commit. For tenants that require immediate side-effects, make them opt-in for direct write mode.

aj: Operational notes: include a chaos probe (cpu + net) during mirror to verify rollback. Add cooldown after enabling write-capture to let caches converge.

maria: Example config: { strategy: shadow_mirror, mirror_mode: read-only, warmup: 10m, enable_write_capture: false, gates: { p95_mult:1.25, err_delta_pct:0.2 }, budget: { soft_usd:200, hard_usd:500 } }

lina: UX: console should show shadow delta (paired metrics) and top mismatches. Single-click rollback for immediate cut.

deploy-bot: canary-runner triggered for inference-runtime run=20260214-3 at 1719550055

maria: Plan: shadow 5% tenants (24h read-only) -> enable write-capture for those tenants (6h) -> promote to 25% with mirror until stable. Will draft RFC and runbook.

kevin: LGTM. Small rename suggestion: mirror_mode_pct -> mirror_behavior_pct.

maria: Will update and ping for review. Thanks. :thumbsup:
